 Aaron-Roy King off to a strong start at Hong Kong Open
 By ADAM ZAMRI 
 Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026
 | 9:46 PM MYT

 PETALING JAYA: Men's doubles pair Aaron Tai-Yap Roy King had little trouble clearing the first round of the Hong Kong Open after defeating Taiwan's Chiu Hsiang-chieh-Wang Chi-lin on Wednesday (Nov 18).
 Fresh from winning the Japan Masters title on Sunday, Aaron-Roy King continued their fine form with a convincing 21-17, 21-14 victory over the Taiwanese pair at the Kai Tak Arena.
 They will next face Indonesia's Leo Rolly-Daniel Marthin in the second round.
 Meanwhile, women's doubles pair Low Zi Yu-Noraqilah Maisarah Ramdan also made a winning start after beating Thailand's Ornnicha Jongsathapornparn-Sabrina Wedler 21-18, 21-16 to book their place in the second round.
 The tournament marks Noraqilah's return to competition after suffering an ankle injury before the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in September.
 However, Zi Yu-Noraqilah face a tougher test in the second round on Thursday, when they take on fourth seeds Hsu Yin-hui-Lin Jhih-yun of Taiwan.
